column2: Seems ironic that a blog post describing GHC's AI policy, from a contributor to GHC, which expresses agreement with GHC's AI policy, itself directly violates GHC's AI policy (points P1 and P4)!

Most important one is human communication.

Use AI as much as you want, for research, writing code, reviewing code, etc.

But please, keep communicating on a human level. We are slowly loosing valuable communities when only bots are arguing with each other.

The original guidelines sound more nuanced:

https://gitlab.haskell.org/ghc/ghc/-/wikis/contributing/AI

To the authors: please include a few words giving context on what a GHC is so people don't have to seek that info out before trying to understand what you're saying

Didn't slow me down too much but was still a hassle.
